action_items.text: Work on questionnaires and summaries regarding the current project status.
Work on individual tasks (components, user interface concepts, and design appearance) after lunch.
A will write the meeting minutes.
C will look at the actual appearance of the remote design in the next break.
B will work on the components (chips, power source) needed for the remote.
B will explore the possibility of a two-piece remote design (one for quick zapping, one for the rounded hand-fit part).
C will work on how the proposed concepts will work with the user.
D will research new trends to gather information for the next meeting.

decisions.text: The remote will be designed specifically for television, not as a universal remote.
The remote will incorporate the corporate colors (grey and yellow) and the slogan 'we put the fashion in electronics'.
Speech recognition will be removed from the project as it is not considered worth the investment at this time.
The remote design should focus on a specific look/trend rather than targeting a specific demographic group.
The remote will feature a minimal number of buttons, including numbers 1-9, volume up/down, channel up/down, power, mute, and a menu button.
The remote will utilize a scrolling function (like a wheel) for navigating menus.
The remote will be designed primarily for right-handed users.
The team will explore a two-piece remote design where a smaller 'zapping' device fits into a larger, rounded hand-fit unit.
